messages.content:
You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
ocbc_skyway | OCBC Skyway | 14 | 30 | 09:00-21:00 | -
gardens_domes | Flower Dome and Cloud Forest | 46 | 120 | 09:00-21:00 | -
spectra | Spectra Light and Water Show | 0 | 15 | 19:45-21:30 | 20:00, 21:00
bird_paradise | Bird Paradise | 49 | 180 | 09:00-18:00 | -
cable_car | Singapore Cable Car | 35 | 45 | 08:45-22:00 | -
tekka_centre | Tekka Centre | 8 | 45 | 06:30-21:00 | -
skypark | Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck | 32 | 60 | 11:00-21:00 | -
orchard_road | Orchard Road | 0 | 120 | 10:00-22:00 | -
botanic_gardens | Singapore Botanic Gardens | 0 | 120 | 05:00-24:00 | -
maxwell | Maxwell Food Centre | 8 | 45 | 08:00-24:00 | -
orchid_garden | National Orchid Garden | 15 | 60 | 08:30-19:00 | -
supertree_grove | Supertree Grove | 0 | 45 | 05:00-24:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
ocbc_skyway: gardens_domes 11, spectra 12, bird_paradise 49, cable_car 23, tekka_centre 18, skypark 11, orchard_road 21, botanic_gardens 26, maxwell 16, orchid_garden 26, supertree_grove 11
gardens_domes: ocbc_skyway 11, spectra 12, bird_paradise 49, cable_car 23, tekka_centre 18, skypark 12, orchard_road 21, botanic_gardens 26, maxwell 16, orchid_garden 26, supertree_grove 11
spectra: ocbc_skyway 12, gardens_domes 12, bird_paradise 48, cable_car 22, tekka_centre 17, skypark 11, orchard_road 20, botanic_gardens 25, maxwell 14, orchid_garden 24, supertree_grove 12
bird_paradise: ocbc_skyway 49, gardens_domes 49, spectra 48, cable_car 47, tekka_centre 42, skypark 49, orchard_road 40, botanic_gardens 36, maxwell 47, orchid_garden 37, supertree_grove 49
cable_car: ocbc_skyway 23, gardens_domes 23, spectra 22, bird_paradise 47, tekka_centre 23, skypark 22, orchard_road 20, botanic_gardens 22, maxwell 18, orchid_garden 21, supertree_grove 23
tekka_centre: ocbc_skyway 18, gardens_domes 18, spectra 17, bird_paradise 42, cable_car 23, skypark 17, orchard_road 16, botanic_gardens 20, maxwell 18, orchid_garden 20, supertree_grove 18
skypark: ocbc_skyway 11, gardens_domes 12, spectra 11, bird_paradise 49, cable_car 22, tekka_centre 17, orchard_road 20, botanic_gardens 25, maxwell 15, orchid_garden 25, supertree_grove 11
orchard_road: ocbc_skyway 21, gardens_domes 21, spectra 20, bird_paradise 40, cable_car 20, tekka_centre 16, skypark 20, botanic_gardens 15, maxwell 18, orchid_garden 15, supertree_grove 21
botanic_gardens: ocbc_skyway 26, gardens_domes 26, spectra 25, bird_paradise 36, cable_car 22, tekka_centre 20, skypark 25, orchard_road 15, maxwell 22, orchid_garden 11, supertree_grove 26
maxwell: ocbc_skyway 16, gardens_domes 16, spectra 14, bird_paradise 47, cable_car 18, tekka_centre 18, skypark 15, orchard_road 18, botanic_gardens 22, orchid_garden 22, supertree_grove 16
orchid_garden: ocbc_skyway 26, gardens_domes 26, spectra 24, bird_paradise 37, cable_car 21, tekka_centre 20, skypark 25, orchard_road 15, botanic_gardens 11, maxwell 22, supertree_grove 26
supertree_grove: ocbc_skyway 11, gardens_domes 11, spectra 12, bird_paradise 49, cable_car 23, tekka_centre 18, skypark 11, orchard_road 21, botanic_gardens 26, maxwell 16, orchid_garden 26

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

My day out runs from 11:00 until 17:50. I can spend at most S$162. I want to visit Bird Paradise. If there's time, I'd also like OCBC Skyway, Flower Dome and Cloud Forest, Spectra Light and Water Show, Singapore Cable Car, Tekka Centre, Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck, Orchard Road, Singapore Botanic Gardens, Maxwell Food Centre, National Orchid Garden and Supertree Grove. I want to do Flower Dome and Cloud Forest before Bird Paradise. I want to be at Flower Dome and Cloud Forest no earlier than 10:30 and done there by 14:00. I'd like to spend 150 minutes at Singapore Botanic Gardens.

response:
```python
import json
from z3 import *

# Create Z3 solver
s = Solver()

# Time bounds: 11:00 (660) to 17:50 (1070)
DAY_START = 660
DAY_END = 1070
BUDGET = 162

# Locations and their properties
# (id, cost, duration, open_start, open_end, showtimes)
locations = {
    "ocbc_skyway": {"cost": 14, "dur": 30, "open": 540, "close": 1260, "shows": []},
    "gardens_domes": {"cost": 46, "dur": 120, "open": 540, "close": 1260, "shows": []},
    "spectra": {"cost": 0, "dur": 15, "open": 1185, "close": 1290, "shows": [1200, 1260]},
    "bird_paradise": {"cost": 49, "dur": 180, "open": 540, "close": 1080, "shows": []},
    "cable_car": {"cost": 35, "dur": 45, "open": 525, "close": 1320, "shows": []},
    "tekka_centre": {"cost": 8, "dur": 45, "open": 390, "close": 1260, "shows": []},
    "skypark": {"cost": 32, "dur": 60, "open": 660, "close": 1260, "shows": []},
    "orchard_road": {"cost": 0, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1320, "shows": []},
    "botanic_gardens": {"cost": 0, "dur": 150, "open": 300, "close": 1440, "shows": []},
    "maxwell": {"cost": 8, "dur": 45, "open": 480, "close": 1440, "shows": []},
    "orchid_garden": {"cost": 15, "dur": 60, "open": 510, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "supertree_grove": {"cost": 0, "dur": 45, "open": 300, "close": 1440, "shows": []}
}

# Travel times in minutes
travel_times = {
    "ocbc_skyway": {"ocbc_skyway": 0, "gardens_domes": 11, "spectra": 12, "bird_paradise": 49, "cable_car": 23, "tekka_centre": 18, "skypark": 11, "orchard_road": 21, "botanic_gardens": 26, "maxwell": 16, "orchid_garden": 26, "supertree_grove": 11},
    "gardens_domes": {"ocbc_skyway": 11, "gardens_domes": 0, "spectra": 12, "bird_paradise": 49, "cable_car": 23, "tekka_centre": 18, "skypark": 12, "orchard_road": 21, "botanic_gardens": 26, "maxwell": 16, "orchid_garden": 26, "supertree_grove": 11},
    "spectra": {"ocbc_skyway": 12, "gardens_domes": 12, "spectra": 0, "bird_paradise": 48, "cable_car": 22, "tekka_centre": 17, "skypark": 11, "orchard_road": 20, "botanic_gardens": 25, "maxwell": 14, "orchid_garden": 24, "supertree_grove": 12},
    "bird_paradise": {"ocbc_skyway": 49, "gardens_domes": 49, "spectra": 48, "bird_paradise": 0, "cable_car": 47, "tekka_centre": 42, "skypark": 49, "orchard_road": 40, "botanic_gardens": 36, "maxwell": 47, "orchid_garden": 37, "supertree_grove": 49},
    "cable_car": {"ocbc_skyway": 23, "gardens_domes": 23, "spectra": 22, "bird_paradise": 47, "cable_car": 0, "tekka_centre": 23, "skypark": 22, "orchard_road": 20, "botanic_gardens": 22, "maxwell": 18, "orchid_garden": 21, "supertree_grove": 23},
    "tekka_centre": {"ocbc_skyway": 18, "gardens_domes": 18, "spectra": 17, "bird_paradise": 42, "cable_car": 23, "tekka_centre": 0, "skypark": 17, "orchard_road": 16, "botanic_gardens": 20, "maxwell": 18, "orchid_garden": 20, "supertree_grove": 18},
    "skypark": {"ocbc_skyway": 11, "gardens_domes": 12, "spectra": 11, "bird_paradise": 49, "cable_car": 22, "tekka_centre": 17, "skypark": 0, "orchard_road": 20, "botanic_gardens": 25, "maxwell": 15, "orchid_garden": 25, "supertree_grove": 11},
    "orchard_road": {"ocbc_skyway": 21, "gardens_domes": 21, "spectra": 20, "bird_paradise": 40, "cable_car": 20, "tekka_centre": 16, "skypark": 20, "botanic_gardens": 15, "maxwell": 18, "orchid_garden": 15, "supertree_grove": 21},
    "botanic_gardens": {"ocbc_skyway": 26, "gardens_domes": 26, "spectra": 25, "bird_paradise": 36, "cable_car": 22, "tekka_centre": 20, "skypark": 25, "orchard_road": 15, "maxwell": 22, "orchid_garden": 11, "supertree_grove": 26},
    "maxwell": {"ocbc_skyway": 16, "gardens_domes": 16, "spectra": 14, "bird_paradise": 47, "cable_car": 18, "tekka_centre": 18, "skypark": 15, "orchard_road": 18, "botanic_gardens": 22, "orchid_garden": 22, "supertree_grove": 16},
    "orchid_garden": {"ocbc_skyway": 26, "gardens_domes": 26, "spectra": 24, "bird_paradise": 37, "cable_car": 21, "tekka_centre": 20, "skypark": 25, "orchard_road": 15, "botanic_gardens": 11, "maxwell": 22, "supertree_grove": 26},
    "supertree_grove": {"ocbc_skyway": 11, "gardens_domes": 11, "spectra": 12, "bird_paradise": 49, "cable_car": 23, "tekka_centre": 18, "skypark": 11, "orchard_road": 21, "botanic_gardens": 26, "maxwell": 16, "orchid_garden": 26, "supertree_grove": 0}
}

# Decision variables
visit = {loc_id: Bool(f"visit_{loc_id}") for loc_id in locations}
start = {loc_id: Int(f"start_{loc_id}") for loc_id in locations}
end = {loc_id: Int(f"end_{loc_id}") for loc_id in locations}

# 1. Must-visit: Bird Paradise
s.add(visit["bird_paradise"])

# 2. Budget constraint
s.add(
    Sum([If(visit[loc_id], locations[loc_id]["cost"], 0) for loc_id in locations])
    <= BUDGET
)

for loc_id, data in locations.items():
    dur = data["dur"]
    if loc_id == "botanic_gardens":
        dur = 150

    # Duration and bounds
    s.add(end[loc_id] == start[loc_id] + dur)
    s.add(
        If(
            visit[loc_id],
            And(
                start[loc_id] >= DAY_START,
                end[loc_id] <= DAY_END,
                start[loc_id] >= data["open"],
                end[loc_id] <= data["close"],
            ),
            True,
        )
    )

    # Showtimes constraint
    if data["shows"]:
        show_conditions = [start[loc_id] == st for st in data["shows"]]
        s.add(If(visit[loc_id], Or(show_conditions), True))

# Specific constraints:
# "I want to do Flower Dome and Cloud Forest before Bird Paradise."
s.add(
    If(
        And(visit["gardens_domes"], visit["bird_paradise"]),
        end["gardens_domes"] <= start["bird_paradise"],
        True,
    )
)

# "I want to be at Flower Dome and Cloud Forest no earlier than 10:30 and done there by 14:00."
s.add(
    If(
        visit["gardens_domes"],
        And(start["gardens_domes"] >= 630, end["gardens_domes"] <= 840),
        True,
    )
)

# Non-overlapping and travel time constraints
loc_ids = list(locations.keys())
for i in range(len(loc_ids)):
    for j in range(len(loc_ids)):
        if i != j:
            loc_i = loc_ids[i]
            loc_j = loc_ids[j]
            travel = travel_times[loc_i][loc_j]
            s.add(
                If(
                    And(visit[loc_i], visit[loc_j]),
                    Or(
                        end[loc_i] + travel <= start[loc_j],
                        end[loc_j] + travel <= start[loc_i],
                    ),
                    True,
                )
            )

# Solve
if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    result = []
    for loc_id in locations:
        if is_true(m[visit[loc_id]]):
            result.append({
                "location_id": loc_id,
                "start": m[start[loc_id]].as_long(),
                "end": m[end[loc_id]].as_long()
            })
    # Sort result by start time
    result.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])
    print(json.dumps(result))
else:
    print("UNSAT")
```
